limitations.note: The rewrite matches the expected waveform for the default parameters, but it changes pulse widths for other divider values and replaces the reset-to-even mode flag with a direct threshold that starts in odd mode when c89 is zero.
The default waveform check could catch the original bug, but the override checks encoded the rewrite’s new pulse widths and odd-only startup as expected, so they could not catch those regressions.
